known_limitations.note: The mermaid flowchart restates the bulleted text and was triaged as context; the 'New Diagnosis After Birth' pointer to separate Urology guidelines was not checked.

The 2025 AAP clinical report on perinatal urinary tract dilation was read as abstract only: no PMC copy, and the publisher's landing page and PDF returned a Cloudflare bot check (HTTP 403); logged and not worked around. Its specific thresholds could not be checked.
The 2013 Indian Society of Pediatric Nephrology guideline is the only source keeping several of the manual's criteria; four logged PubMed searches (2013-2026) found no newer version.

The AUA guideline web page states its content may not be uploaded into external applications, including AI tools, without permission; whether quoting it in a published AI-generated note is acceptable is for the protocol leads to confirm.

Not applied: c8 summary comma splice ('..., so a 1-month US falls within each of these intervals, the Swiss consensus recommends'), Damasio hedge and hyphenation in location fields, position of the [Swiss2024] citation in the c11 summary.
